ev.q: the annual number of pediatric ingestions of melatonin increased 530% with a total of 260,435 ingestions reported
Among all melatonin ingestions, 4,555 (1.6%) resulted in more serious outcomes.
Most hospitalized patients were teenagers with intentional ingestions, whereas the largest increase in hospitalization occurred among children aged ≤5 years with unintentional ingestions.
This was a cross-sectional study of pediatric melatonin ingestions reported to U.S. poison control centers.

methods_quotes.q: Standard descriptive statistics were used to describe and compare variables of interest.
Rates (exposures per 100,000 population aged ≤19 years) were calculated using population estimates from the U.S. Census Bureau
